mythManifests.name: Operatic Reflection
mythManifests.bonus: Amplifies Lingering Glow & Burn detonation DMG by +35% and inflicts Halo stacks.

mythManifests.name: Star of Misfortune
mythManifests.bonus: Boosts Impromptu Inspiration & Conduit Crit DMG while generating +2 Eureka per round.

mythManifests.name: Mountain Ghost
mythManifests.bonus: Converts allied HP drain into thicker Bloodtithe Pool charges and grants teamwide Leech.

mythManifests.name: Ashen Beast
mythManifests.bonus: Accelerates Pulsing Electric Field to Level 3 and triggers chain electromagnetic follow-ups.

mythManifests.name: Primitive Urge
mythManifests.bonus: Provides teamwide cleanse, Genesis DMG amplification, and +1 Moxie to Slot 1 Carry.

euphoriaPaths.name: A moment of shimmering fate
euphoriaPaths.rank1: [Nothing Unexpected]'s [Vision] stacks granted are additionally increased by 100% of the original base amount, and grants [Foresight] for 2 rounds.
euphoriaPaths.rank2:
[Clairvoyant Prism] gains new effects:
[Emanation of Blue]: Consumes 3 stacks of [Vision]; when [Destined Doom] is cast this round, deals additional Mental DMG equal to 35% of the original base Mental DMG, up to 1/2/3 times at Incantation rank 1/2/3; and at the end of the round, self Moxie +1.
[Emanation of Purple]: Extends [Foresight]'s duration by 1/1/2 round(s); consumes 3 stacks of [Vision]; when [Destined Doom] is cast this round, for every point of [Lingering Glow], deals additional Mental DMG equal to 100% of the original additional Mental DMG per point of [Lingering Glow], up to 1/2/3 times at Incantation rank 1/2/3, and at the end of the round, self Moxie +1.
[Emanation of Green]: Consumes 3 stacks of [Vision]; when [Destined Doom] is cast this round at rank 1/2/3, deals additional Mental DMG equal to 150% of the original additional Mental DMG at rank 1/2/3, up to 1/2/3 times at Incantation rank 1/2/3, and at the end of the round, self Moxie +1.
euphoriaPaths.rank3:
[A Shimmering Night]'s Mental DMG dealt is increased, equal to 100% of the base Mental DMG, and gains a new effect: this attack is affected by 100% Incantation Might; when attacking, for every point of [Lingering Glow], deals an additional 2% Mental DMG; after attacking, self gains 10 stacks of [Vision].
[Prism Mirror] gains a new effect: When entering battle, self gains 10 stacks of [Vision].
euphoriaPaths.rank4: [Destined Doom]'s Mental DMG dealt is increased, equal to 20% of the base Mental DMG; for every stack of [Vision] held, this attack's ATK is increased by 0.2%, counting up to 20 stacks.

euphoriaPaths.name: Fluttering Toward the Dusk Eternal
euphoriaPaths.rank1:
New Effects Added: Accumulates [Lingering Glow] (mutually exclusive with [Bloodtithe]) whenever an enemy is inflicted with [Burn] or [Halo].
[Desired Freedom] now reduces both Reality DEF and Mental DEF.
euphoriaPaths.rank2:
[Choking on Blood] no longer grants [Rousing Morale] to all allies. [Finale] no longer grants [Power Burst] to all allies.
[Interlude] New Effects Added: At the start of the round, grants [Acciaccatura] to all allies for 1 round.
[Finale] New Effects Added: At the start of the round, grants [Appoggiatura] to all allies for 1 round.
euphoriaPaths.rank3: [Intermezzo] New Effects Added: For every stack of [Burn] on the target, this attack gains Incantation Might +1.5%, counting up to 30 stacks of [Burn]. At 100/200/300 points of [Lingering Glow] or above, this attack gains an additional Incantation Might +10%/20%/30%; at 300 points of [Lingering Glow] or above, this attack gains Penetration Rate +30%.
euphoriaPaths.rank4:
[Intermezzo] New Effects Added: Deals an additional 2% Reality DMG for every point of [Lingering Glow]; at 150 points of [Lingering Glow] or above, grants Moxie +1.
[Prelude], [Interlude], and [Finale] New Effects Added: 5%/10%/15% of the [Lingering Glow] points depleted at the start of the round will be reaccumulated after the next cast of [Intermezzo].

euphoriaPaths.name: Burning Bright Beneath the Darkest Night
euphoriaPaths.rank1:
[Weaver of Light]: After being attacked while in the [Mother Spirit's Guidance] status, Nautika now gains 2 stacks of [Higge].
[No Longer Poles Apart]: Nautika now gains 2 stacks of [Higge] after taking an action.
Each stack of [Higge] now grants an additional DMG Bonus +1%.
euphoriaPaths.rank2:
[Ice Core Drilling] now deals an additional 110% Reality DMG based on Max HP.
[Martyr of the Abyss] now deals (number of characters present x75%) Reality DMG.
euphoriaPaths.rank3:
[Divine Yoik] New Effects: When attacking, gains Ultimate Might +15% if under [Adversity I] and [Mother Spirit's Guidance] statuses at the same time.
[Divine Yoik]: [A Thousand Scars] and [A Thousand Springs] now deal 115% Reality DMG based on Max HP.
euphoriaPaths.rank4:
[No Longer Poles Apart] Enhancements: Cannot be reduced below 16% HP by HP loss effects; when entering battle, Nautika grants this HP loss limit to all other [Bloodtithe] allies.
[No Longer Poles Apart]: [Mouth of the Mother] now deals an additional 115% Reality DMG based on Max HP.

euphoriaPaths.name: The Red from a Thousand Moons
euphoriaPaths.rank1:
Whenever an ally loses HP, accumulates points of [Bloodtithe].
When entering battle, gain Max HP +50% and grant (Semmelweis's Max HP x10%) Max HP to other allies.
euphoriaPaths.rank2:
[Effective Means] Enhancement: DMG dealt by allies under the [Fresh Blood] status is additionally increased by 10% and the duration of the granted statuses is increased to 3 rounds.
[Fresh Blood]'s effect changed to: When taking an action, lose 10% of current HP. Critical Rate +20%. Critical DMG +20%.
euphoriaPaths.rank3:
For every 8 [Bloodtithe] points gained by the team, gain Moxie +1 for self.
[Truth Revealed] deals (30% of own Max HP instead of ATK) Reality DMG plus 100% Reality DMG and grants [Bloodtithe] points +2.
euphoriaPaths.rank4:
[Blood Domain] Additional Effects: All allies' Healing Taken +10%. For every 10% missing Max HP on allies, they gain an additional Healing Taken +4% (up to 32%).
When under [Blood Domain], if max [Bloodtithe] reaches 50/70, after an ally takes an action, they lose 5% of current HP and gain Extra Action DMG Dealt +15%/30%. If the ally has [Fresh Blood], they gain an additional Extra Action DMG Dealt +10%/20%.

euphoriaPaths.name: The Last Page Torn from the Script
euphoriaPaths.rank1:
[Flood of Fiction] will now apply to the ally with the highest Moxie, excluding Recoleta.
New Effect: Ultimates cast via [Flood of Fiction] grant double the number of [Monomythic Narrative]/[Ensemble Narrative] stacks and grant Moxie +1 to Recoleta.
euphoriaPaths.rank2: [Maze of Visceral Realism]: Deals an additional (base Reality DMG x100%) Reality DMG. Deals another additional (base Reality DMG x100%) Reality DMG to the main target. For each additional Moxie consumed, gains an additional (base Ultimate Might x100%) Ultimate Might.
euphoriaPaths.rank3: [Monomythic Narrative]/[Ensemble Narrative] deals an additional (base Reality DMG x100%) Reality DMG. New Effect: When casting [Maze of Visceral Realism], DMG Dealt +1%, up to 40 stacks.
euphoriaPaths.rank4: [Spontaneous Writing]: Max Moxie Bonus increased to +8.

euphoriaPaths.name: The Dawn Waits at the End of the Stairs
euphoriaPaths.rank1: At the start of the round, if not under a [Pulsing Field] of any level, deploy [Pulsing Field Lv.1]. After casting a reinforced incantation, transfer up to 10 stacks of [Dynamo] into the [Pulsing Field].
euphoriaPaths.rank2: When entering battle, gain 20 stacks of [Dynamo]. After reinforcing an incantation, gain 1 stack of [Data Iteration].
euphoriaPaths.rank3: Gain [Amplified Surge].
euphoriaPaths.rank4: Reinforced incantations no longer consume [Dynamo]. No longer gains [Dynamo] when an enemy is defeated. When under a [Pulsing Field], reinforced incantations additionally deal ([Conservation of Energy]'s Reality DMG x50/70/120%) Reality DMG based on the array's level. When under [Pulsing Field Lv.3], for every stack of [Dynamo] owned, reinforced incantations additionally deal 8% Reality DMG. Reinforced incantations benefit from Ultimate Might at a 100% rate, and for every stack of [Data Iteration] owned, this rate increases by 10%.

euphoriaPaths.name: Measuring Thousands of Miles by Hand
euphoriaPaths.rank1:
[Interdisciplinary Research] New Effects Added: For each excess Eureka gained, gains 2 stacks of [Measure]. Ultimate does not take up the allied Incantation Draw Limit.
[Long Long Journey] New Effects Added: Removes all [Measure] stacks after acting.
[Mapping] no longer grants [Measure] based on excess Eureka.
euphoriaPaths.rank2: [Practicability] now deals (base Mental DMG x100%) additional Mental DMG.
euphoriaPaths.rank3: [Rehabilitation] now deals (base Mental DMG from consuming Eureka x20%) additional Mental DMG; when attacking, for each stack of [Measure], deals (base Mental DMG x4%) additional Mental DMG.
euphoriaPaths.rank4: [Measure]'s stack limit is increased to 55 and its duration limit is removed.

euphoriaPaths.name: Echoes of Gilded Elegance
euphoriaPaths.rank1:
New Effects Added: After the [Bound] ally performs an extra action, the binding between them and Anjo Nala is enhanced, and both gain 1 stack of [Harmonic Tapestry]. [Harmonic Tapestry] is stackable up to 8 times. Additional effects based on binding type:
Spirit/Intellect [Mind and Flesh]: ATK +2%.
Beast/Plant [Bone and Blood]: Ultimate Might +6%.
Star/Mineral [Form and Phantom]: Extra Action DMG +10%.
euphoriaPaths.rank2: New Effects Added: When casting [Interwoven Dreams], the Current HP consumed is reduced from 50% to 15%. When the binding is enhanced, Anjo Nala gains Moxie +1 and 2 stacks of [Ceremonious: Critical DMG] (4 extra stacks of [Ceremonious: Critical DMG] for [Bone and Blood]).
euphoriaPaths.rank3: [Interwoven Dreams] New Effects Added: After attacking, gains [The Final Sustain] for 2 rounds: [Feast of Lust] and [Angel's Temptation] deal an additional (base Mental DMG x300%) Mental DMG.
euphoriaPaths.rank4:
New Effects Added: At 8 stacks of [Harmonic Tapestry], [Interwoven Dreams] no longer consumes AP nor takes up the allied Incantation Draw Limit, and it also grants Moxie +2 after casting. Additional effects for Anjo Nala based on binding type:
Spirit/Intellect [Mind and Flesh]: [Feast of Lust] deals an additional 400% Mental DMG and accelerates [Hymn] channeling by 1 round.
Beast/Plant [Bone and Blood]: [Interwoven Dreams] deals an additional (base Mental DMG x140%) Mental DMG. [Interwoven Dreams]'s Ultimate Might enhancement is doubled.
Star/Mineral [Form and Phantom]:When attacking with [Angel's Temptation], deals an additional (base Mental DMG x200%) Mental DMG and excess Critical Rate is converted to Critical DMG.

euphoriaPaths.name: Flourish in the Face of Danger
euphoriaPaths.rank1: [More Than Alchemy] New Effects Added: Removes all of Lopera's basic incantations from the Spelldock; for each incantation removed, based on its rank, gains 4/6/10 stacks of [Flaming Bullet].
euphoriaPaths.rank2:
[Double Backups] New Effects Added: Deals (base Reality DMG x20%) additional Reality DMG and is guaranteed to crit.
[Bull's Eye] New Effects Added: Deals (base Reality DMG x20%) additional Reality DMG and is guaranteed to crit.
euphoriaPaths.rank3: [More Than Alchemy] New Effects Added: Gains Moxie +1 after acting.
euphoriaPaths.rank4: [Crucible Arsenal]: Bullet type count is increased to 8. New Effects Added: When attacking, for each type of Bullet, DMG Dealt +5%, Incantation Might +5%, and Ultimate Might +5%, up to 8 times.

euphoriaPaths.name: May Blessings Follow the Journey Home
euphoriaPaths.rank1: ['To Family'] enhanced: when [Battle Stance] reaches 10 or more stacks, grant [Subjectivity] to all allies for 1 turn.
euphoriaPaths.rank2: ['To Family'] enhanced: [Battle Formation] increases the Ultimate DMG granted per stack by an additional 20% of its base value. [Armament Maintenance] increases its granted Crit Rate by an additional 20% of its base value.
euphoriaPaths.rank3: [The Homecomer Who Found the Way] (Ultimate) deals additional Reality DMG equal to 100% of base Reality DMG; both direct and Counter casts apply the added damage and [Ceremonious: Crit DMG]. If [Collapsed Past] (Skill 1) is used while already holding [Continuous Action I], it deals additional Reality DMG equal to 100% of base Reality DMG. After attacking, it applies 2 stacks of [Moxie Drain].
euphoriaPaths.rank4: [Tomorrow Regained] (Skill 2) grants [Flash Attack] for 2 turns. [Flash Attack]: when an ally is hit, Moldir counters with [Collapsed Past] at the corresponding rank (once per turn). At the start of the turn, if not in [Doctrine], grant [Overcome Hardship] for 1 turn.

euphoriaPaths.name: Ideals on Her Shoulder
euphoriaPaths.rank1: After an allied character is attacked, if their HP is below 70%, Vila casts a rank 1 [Wordless Song] to them, up to 2 times per round.
euphoriaPaths.rank2: When entering battle, Vila gains Healing Done +7% for every 1000 Max HP she has, and Moxie +1.
euphoriaPaths.rank3: [Rusalka] New Effect Added: the non-ranked Ultimates cast by Plant, Spirit, and Intellect characters count as rank 3 incantations. When in the [Rusalka] status, Vila can obtain Ultimate. At the start of the round, if in the [Rusalka] status, gains rank +1 for a random incantation.
euphoriaPaths.rank4: [Song of Inspiration] New Effect Added: Grants [Song of Passion] to the target and gains Moxie +1. [Song of Generosity] and [Song of Passion] can be granted to multiple targets.

euphoriaPaths.name: A Crystal-Clear Tomorrow
euphoriaPaths.rank1:
Gain Max Eureka +5. At the start of the round, gain Eureka +4. Whenever an ally consumes Eureka, accumulate points of [Inspiration]. When entering battle, accumulate 3 points of [Inspiration].
After casting [Work of Genius] or [Attention Everyone], consume 2 Eureka to grant Critical Rate +15% to [Impromptu Incantation] for the round. If [Impromptu Incantation] has at least 5 points of [Inspiration], [Impromptu Incantation] gains an additional Critical DMG +20%.
euphoriaPaths.rank2: After casting [Work of Genius] or [Attention Everyone] and consuming Eureka, if [Impromptu Incantation] has at least 10 points of Inspiration, [Impromptu Incantation] gains an additional Critical DMG +30%.
euphoriaPaths.rank3: After casting [Instant of Prediction], grants 8 points of [Inspiration] and an additional Critical Rate +15% to [Impromptu Incantation] for the round. If [Impromptu Incantation] has at least 10 points of [Inspiration], [Impromptu Incantation] gains an additional Critical DMG +50%.
euphoriaPaths.rank4: After casting [Instant of Prediction], if [Impromptu Incantation] has at least 10 points of Inspiration, [Impromptu Incantation] is always a critical hit.

euphoriaPaths.name: A Dazzling Road to Victory
euphoriaPaths.rank1: [The Proud Star]'s Insight I gains a new effect: Whenever an enemy is inflicted with [Burn] or [Ring of Light], accumulates [Lingering Glow]; before attacking, Matilda inflicts 3 stacks of [Ring of Light] on the target.
euphoriaPaths.rank2:
[The Proud Star]'s Insight III gains a new effect: If Beryl is present in the team, after Beryl actively casts [Blaze Through the Lens], Matilda additionally casts a rank 1 [Work of Genius].
[Work of Genius]'s effect is enhanced: Deals additional Mental DMG equal to 200% of the base Mental DMG; if the target's [Ring of Light] reaches 5/10/20/30 stacks, increases all allies' Critical Rate by 25%/50%/75%/100% for 3 rounds.
euphoriaPaths.rank3:
[The Proud Star]'s Insight III gains a new effect: If Beryl is present in the team, after Beryl actively casts [Nothing Unexpected], Matilda additionally casts a rank 1 [Attention Everyone].
[Attention Everyone]'s effect is enhanced: Deals additional Mental DMG equal to 200% of the base Mental DMG; if the primary target's [Ring of Light] reaches 5/10/20/30 stacks, increases self ATK by 15%/25%/50%/80% for 3 rounds.
euphoriaPaths.rank4:
[The Proud Star]'s Insight III gains a new effect: If Beryl is present in the team, after Beryl actively casts [A Shimmering Night], Matilda additionally casts [Instant of Prediction].
[Instant of Prediction]'s effect is enhanced: Deals additional Mental DMG equal to 200% of the base Mental DMG; after attacking, inflicts [Deflection] on the target for 3 rounds.

euphoriaPaths.name: The Many Whispers Heard from a Room
euphoriaPaths.rank1: At the end of the round, if this unit was not attacked for the round, gain Moxie +1.
euphoriaPaths.rank2: At the end of the round, inflict 1 stack of [Weakness] on enemy units that did not attack this unit during the round.
euphoriaPaths.rank3: Gain an additional DMG Dealt +10% against enemies holding a [Stats Down], [Neg Status], or [Control] status.
euphoriaPaths.rank4: When casting [Uninvited Reviewer], Penetration Rate +30% for self. Right before casting [Uninvited Reviewer], inflict Critical DEF -20% on the target for 2 rounds.

euphoriaPaths.name: Agent of Priceless Spectacles
euphoriaPaths.rank1: [Beautiful Lie] Insight I adjustments: After entering battle, immediately casts a rank 1 [A Bouquet of Galaxy] (triggers up to 1 time); at the start of odd-numbered rounds, gain 1 [Diamond Bullet] for self.
euphoriaPaths.rank2: When casting [A Sincere Heart], for each type of Bullet held by all allies, the attack deals an additional 40% Reality DMG, this effect can deal up to an additional 200% Reality DMG.
euphoriaPaths.rank3: After an ally takes an action, if this unit is holding at least 2 stacks of [Diamond Bullet], casts a rank 1 [A Shiny Diamond] (triggers up to 1 time per round).
euphoriaPaths.rank4: Whenever this unit triggers 2 [Diamond Bullet], immediately casts a rank 1 [A Bouquet of Galaxy] (triggers up to 1 time per round).

euphoriaPaths.name: The Verdance Among Stones
euphoriaPaths.rank1: Enhances [Circle of Life] with extra effects: gain DMG Bonus +15%, Penetration Rate +15%, and the effect becomes undispellable.
euphoriaPaths.rank2: Enhances [Circle of Life] with an extra effect: for every 200 ATK Druvis III has, gain an additional DMG Bonus +1%.
euphoriaPaths.rank3: Enhances [Circle of Life] with extra effects: attacking enemies in the [Petrify] status does not remove the [Petrify] status, and gain an additional Penetration Rate +25% against targets in the [Petrify] status.
euphoriaPaths.rank4: Enhances [Circle of Life] with an extra effect: Gain ATK equal to 7.5% of Druvis III's Mental DEF.

euphoriaPaths.name: Rising from the Ashes
euphoriaPaths.rank1: [Circle of Life] new effect: When attacking, inflicts 1/2/3 stacks of [Firebud] (undispellable) on the target hit based on incantation rank.
euphoriaPaths.rank2: [Firebud] new effect: Critical Resist Rate -15%. Critical DEF -30%. For every additional stack, gets an additional Critical Resist Rate -1.5% and Critical DEF -3%.
euphoriaPaths.rank3:
When entering battle, if there are at least 3 [Plant] allies on the team, enhances [Circle of Life]:
The [Circle of Life] on the adjacent ally in front grants an additional Penetration Rate +40%.
The [Circle of Life] on the adjacent ally behind grants an additional DMG Taken Reduction +30%.
euphoriaPaths.rank4:
When entering battle, if there are at least 3 [Plant] allies on the team, enhances [Circle of Life]:
When [Firebud] explodes, for every stack, all allies gain DMG Bonus +6% for 2 rounds.

euphoriaPaths.name: What Roars Like a Victory Song?
euphoriaPaths.rank1: When attacking, excess Critical Rate is converted into Critical DMG; after scoring a critical hit, gain 1 stack of [Intense Fervor] for self; when casting an ultimate, consume all stacks of [Intense Fervor] to gain an equal number of Moxie.
euphoriaPaths.rank2: When an extra action scores a critical hit, gain 2 stacks of [Ceremonious].
euphoriaPaths.rank3: When [Aerial Maneuvers] scores a critical hit at incantation rank 1/2/3, performs 1 extra attack that deals 80%/120%/200% Reality DMG. This extra attack is regarded as 1 extra action.
euphoriaPaths.rank4: When casting an ultimate, deal an additional 30% Reality DMG for each stack of [Ceremonious] held; up to 15 stacks can be used to count toward this bonus.

euphoriaPaths.name: The Kamchatka Hunt
euphoriaPaths.rank1: Incantation Might +5%; when attacking, excess Critical Rate is converted to Critical DMG.
euphoriaPaths.rank2: At the start of the round, gain 1 [Pointed Bullet]. When scoring a critical hit, there's a 50% chance to gain 1 [Pointed Bullet].
euphoriaPaths.rank3: When [Aerial Maneuvers] scores a critical hit at incantation rank 1/2/3, performs 1 extra attack that deals 80%/120%/200% Reality DMG. This extra attack is regarded as 1 extra action.
euphoriaPaths.rank4: After [Pointed Bullet] is triggered at least twice in one round, get Incantation Might +20% when attacking for the rest of the round.

euphoriaPaths.name: Echoes Pour from the Heavens to the Earth Below
euphoriaPaths.rank1:
When entering battle, gains 4 stacks of [Virtues] and 1 stack of [Rousing Morale].
At the start of the round, if A Knight has at least 2 stacks of [Virtues], consumes 2 stacks of [Virtues] to immediately cast [After AD 778]. This attack counts as an extra action.
euphoriaPaths.rank2:
[Justice] deals an additional (base Reality DMG x100%) Reality DMG. This attack benefits from Ultimate Might at a 100% rate. After attacking, gains 8/10/12 stacks of [Ceremonious: Ultimate Might].
[Glory] deals an additional (base Reality DMG x100%) Reality DMG. This attack benefits from Ultimate Might at a 100% rate. After attacking, gains 8/10/12 stacks of [Ceremonious: Critical DMG].
euphoriaPaths.rank3: [After AD 778] deals an additional (base Reality DMG x60% x number of enemies) Reality DMG. When actively cast, it deals an additional (base Reality DMG x120% x number of enemies) Reality DMG and grants 1 stack of [Virtues] to A Knight. For every enemy [After AD 778] defeats, A Knight gains 1 stack of [Virtues].
euphoriaPaths.rank4: [Mercy]: For every 20% Remaining HP (formerly every 20% Missing HP) on the enemy, A Knight gains Critical Rate +8% when attacking them.

euphoriaPaths.name: A Drop of Creativity, an Ocean of Naivety
euphoriaPaths.rank1:
[Cure] Enhancement: After being attacked, if own current HP is below 40%, this effect is triggered immediately and the duration is reduced by 1 round. This effect also becomes stackable.
[Genius Lady] Insight III upgrade: The [Cure] that is granted by [Concentrated Essence!] gains +1 round duration.
euphoriaPaths.rank2: When entering battle, Sotheby gains Healing Done +7% for every 1000 Max HP she has.
euphoriaPaths.rank3: When entering battle, Sotheby gains Poison DMG Bonus +2% for every 100 ATK she has.
euphoriaPaths.rank4: At the start of the round, grant 1 stack of [Duality Potion] to self.

euphoriaPaths.name: Shine Bright Like Regulus
euphoriaPaths.rank1:
Gain Max Eureka +5. At the start of the round, gain Eureka +4. Whenever an ally consumes Eureka, accumulate points of [Inspiration]. When entering battle, accumulate 3 points of [Inspiration]. Starting from round 2, at the start of every round, generate 1 Precast Incantation [Rock 'n' Roll Forever!].
When entering battle, gain [Restless Heart]. [Restless Heart] removes after landing a non-critical attack. The effect of gaining Moxie when [Restless Heart] is dispelled is replaced with gaining 1 stack of [Sturdiness] if in [Restless Heart] at the start of the round.
euphoriaPaths.rank2: After casting [Treat for the Ears] or [Challenge for the Eyes], consume 2 Eureka and gain [Impromptu Incantation] attack instances +1 for the round.
euphoriaPaths.rank3: [Sleepless Rave]: Grant 8 points of [Inspiration] to [Impromptu Incantation] for the round.
euphoriaPaths.rank4: At the start of the round, inflicts the [Rockstar Spotlight] status on the main target for 1 round after the adjacent ally in front performs their attack for the round.

euphoriaPaths.name: Rock 'n' Roar
euphoriaPaths.rank1:
No longer generates basic incantations or Ultimates. Casts incantations by activating a [Conduit] with Energy instead.
Moxie is replaced with Harmonization.
[Sleepless Rave]: [Riot and Roll] now loses 1 stack after trigger. After attacking, switches to [Treat for the Ears] if only 1 enemy target is present; otherwise, switches to [Challenge for the Eyes].
[Treat for the Ears] now deals (rank 1 base Mental DMG x160%) Mental DMG and inflicts Moxie -1 when scoring a critical hit, up to 1 time per round.
[Challenge for the Eyes] now deals (rank 1 base Mental DMG x160%) Mental DMG to 2 enemies and inflicts Moxie -1 when scoring a critical hit, up to 1 time per round.
euphoriaPaths.rank2:
[Listen to New Stuff] Insight I effects changed to: At the start of the round, enters the [Restless Heart] status.
[Listen to New Stuff] Insight III effects changed to: At the end of the round, if Regulus is in the [Restless Heart] status, she gains Harmonization +15. When entering battle, Regulus gains Harmonization +65.
[Restless Heart] effects changed to: Critical Rate +50%. Excess Critical Rate is converted into Critical DMG. Removed after an attack does not crit.
euphoriaPaths.rank3:
[Treat for the Ears] New Effects: For each level of [Conduit Activation], deals an additional (rank 1 base Mental DMG x32%) Mental DMG (counting up to 20 levels).
[Challenge for the Eyes] New Effects: For each level of [Conduit Activation], deals an additional (rank 1 base Mental DMG x32%) Mental DMG (counting up to 20 levels).
euphoriaPaths.rank4: [Sleepless Rave] additionally deals (base Mental DMG x120%) Mental DMG and enables Regulus to increase [Conduit Activation] by 1 additional level after she attacks for the rest of the round.

euphoriaPaths.name: Fortune Favors My Path
euphoriaPaths.rank1:
When entering battle, Max Moxie +5.
[Victorious General] deals an additional Reality DMG equal to 300% of [Victorious General]'s original Moxie-based additional Reality DMG.
[Outdoor Superstar] deals an additional Reality DMG equal to 225% of [Victorious General]'s original Moxie-based additional Reality DMG.
[Victorious General] and [Outdoor Superstar] benefit from Ultimate Might at a 100% rate.
euphoriaPaths.rank2: When casting [Victorious General], if below 7 Moxie, gains Moxie +1; if at 7 Moxie or above, consumes 2 Moxie to deal an additional 240%/360%/600% Reality DMG based on incantation rank.
euphoriaPaths.rank3: When casting [Outdoor Superstar], if below 7 Moxie, gains Moxie +1; if at 7 Moxie or above, consumes 2 Moxie to deal an additional 180%/270%/450% Reality DMG based on incantation rank.
euphoriaPaths.rank4: [Reality Show Premiere] no longer consumes Moxie. It grants [Heaven's Bounty] status to self for 3 rounds.

euphoriaPaths.name: Hanging by a Thread, Yet Full of Zest
euphoriaPaths.rank1:
[Hot Sauce Expert]'s Insight I gains a new effect:
Moxie is replaced by Thread Points; self skills that gain benefits based on Moxie are changed to gain benefits based on Thread Points instead. The Ultimate no longer counts toward the Spelldock Draw Limit.
At the start of the round, generates 1 [Thread: Heaven's Fortune] at a random position other than self's own position (up to 4 Threads may exist at each position).
[Victorious General] gains a new effect: Shifts self 1 position forward after casting.
[Outdoor Superstar] gains a new effect: Shifts self 1 position backward after casting.
euphoriaPaths.rank2:
[Victorious General]'s effect is enhanced: Deals additional Reality DMG equal to 100% of the base Reality DMG.
[Outdoor Superstar]'s effect is enhanced: Deals additional Reality DMG equal to 100% of the base Reality DMG.

euphoriaPaths.rank4:
[Hot Sauce Expert]'s Insight III gains a new effect: When entering battle, self Thread Points +3.
[Reality Show Premiere] gains a new effect: If holding 4/5/6 Thread Points when cast, grants all allied characters 1/2/3 stack(s) of [Fortune].

euphoriaPaths.name: Scientifically Handling the Unscientific
euphoriaPaths.rank1: [Time to Work] Insight I Enhancement: When entering [Exorcism Time], grants rank +1 to the rightmost incantation of an ally in front. When entering [Break Time], grants 1 stack of [Sturdiness] to an ally behind.
euphoriaPaths.rank2:
[Exorcism Time] Enhancement: After attacking, randomly inflicts 1 of the following effects on the target: 1 stack of [Rigidity], [Poison] for 2 rounds, or 5 stacks of [Burn].
[Lily Nectar] additionally grants the above new effects of [Exorcism Time] to allies.
euphoriaPaths.rank3:
[Exorcism Time] Enhancement: When the enemy is afflicted with [Stats Down], [Neg Status], or [Control], the DMG Bonus is increased by an additional 15%.
[Break Time] Enhancement: When the enemy is afflicted with [Stats Down], [Neg Status], or [Control], the DMG Taken Reduction is increased by an additional 15%.
euphoriaPaths.rank4: [Scientific Ghost Buster] Enhancement: Grants [Empower Incantation II] to self for 2 rounds; for each enemy attacked that's with [Neg Status], grant [Empower Incantation I] to a random ally for 2 rounds.

euphoriaPaths.name: Exorcism Services at the Speed of Thought
euphoriaPaths.rank1:
Gain Max Eureka +5. At the start of the round, gain Eureka +4. Whenever an ally consumes Eureka, accumulate points of [Inspiration]. When entering battle, accumulate 3 points of [Inspiration].
When An-an Lee's incantations enter the AP area, consumes as much Eureka as possible to increase their incantation rank (prioritizing incantations earlier in the queue): increasing an incantation from rank 1 to 2 or from rank 2 to 3 costs 1 Eureka each.
When an enemy or ally enters battle, 1 [Wandering Spirit] will appear beside them. When the user is under [Exorcism Time] status, captures [Wandering Spirit] on the enemy/allied side (up to 12).
At the start of each round, accumulates points of [Inspiration] equal to the number of captured [Wandering Spirit].
euphoriaPaths.rank2: [Taoist Rune] New Effects Added: At rank 1/2/3, grants Incantation Might +(rank 3 [Taoist Rune]'s base Reality DMG x15%) to the first 3/4/5 [Impromptu Incantation] attacks this round (casting this incantation again only increases the number of attacks to enhance).
euphoriaPaths.rank3: [Lily Nectar] New Effects Added: Grants an additional DMG Bonus +([Scientific Ghost Buster]'s base Reality DMG x20% minus 60%). Duration increased to 3 rounds.
euphoriaPaths.rank4: [Scientific Ghost Buster] New Effects Added: Grants (number of [Wandering Spirit] x2) points of [Inspiration] to [Impromptu Incantation] for the round. The first 5 [Impromptu Incantation] attacks this round gain Incantation Might +(rank 3 [Taoist Rune]'s base Reality DMG x15%) (casting this again only increases the number of attacks to enhance).

euphoriaPaths.name: The Mad Alchemy of Blood
euphoriaPaths.rank1: [Alchemy Ware]: If a target is at 50% HP or below, recover (the user's ATK x Healing Multiplier) HP to that target; if a target is above 50% HP, that target gains a Shield with (the user's ATK x Healing Multiplier x 120%) HP for 2 rounds.
euphoriaPaths.rank2: [Inherent Habit]: When cast, lose (own Current HP x10%) HP and inflict Critical Resist Rate -30% and Critical DEF -40% on the target for 2 rounds.
euphoriaPaths.rank3:
After an ally is attacked, this unit casts a rank 1 [Alchemy Ware] as a follow-up attack (can trigger up to 2 times per round);
When casting [Alchemy Ware], cause all allies to lose (Current HP x10%) HP; and if a target is at 50% HP or below, recover an additional (the user's Missing HP x25%) HP for that target.
euphoriaPaths.rank4: [26 Secondary Reactions]: When cast, lose (own current HP x20%) HP and deal an additional (own Missing HP x150%) Genesis DMG.

euphoriaPaths.name: Drink Deep, Cerulean Waves So Blue
euphoriaPaths.rank1: After attacking, consume (their own Max HP x10%) HP from all allies to deal an additional (the team's combined Max HP x7%) Genesis DMG to the target; if an ally's HP is already below 50%, that ally does not lose HP this way.
euphoriaPaths.rank2: When entering battle, grant (Eternity's Max HP x5%) Max HP to other allies.
euphoriaPaths.rank3: At the start of the round, for every 10% missing Max HP on an ally, grant DMG Taken -5% to that ally, stacking up to 25%.
euphoriaPaths.rank4: When an ally attacks, for every 10% Missing Max HP the ally has, the ally gains Critical Rate +4% and Critical DMG +6% (stacks up to 5 times); if the ally's HP is below 50%, then the ally's excess Critical Rate is converted to Critical DMG.

euphoriaPaths.name: Turn of the Tide
euphoriaPaths.rank1: Whenever an ally loses HP, accumulate points of [Bloodtithe]. When entering battle, gain [Blood of Immortality]. [Blood of Immortality] Enhancement: At the start of the round, consume all allies' (Current HP x20%) HP; if there are 10/20/30 Bloodtithe points, consume them to upgrade [Blood of Immortality]; at rank I/II/III, [Blood of Immortality] grants Max HP +10/30/60%, and ATK +50/70/120 for every 1000 Max HP owned.
euphoriaPaths.rank2: When [Blood of Immortality] reaches rank II, [Vigor Handbag] [Vintage Handfan] grants Moxie +1.
euphoriaPaths.rank3: When [Blood of Immortality] reaches rank III, [Anecdotes in Exeter] is guaranteed to crit and deals an additional (base Reality DMG x100%) Reality DMG.
euphoriaPaths.rank4: At the start of the round, if [Blood of Immortality] is at rank III, consumes 10 [Bloodtithe] points to cast [Anecdotes in Exeter].

euphoriaPaths.name: A Lofty Spire, Risen to Aspire
euphoriaPaths.rank1: When casting [A New Wave], if the target already has a Shield, [A New Wave]'s Shield is stacked onto that existing Shield; this stacking effect cannot exceed 200% of the original Shield's maximum value.
euphoriaPaths.rank2: When an ally attacks, the ally gains Critical Rate +1% for every 300 Shield value the ally has.
euphoriaPaths.rank3: [A New Wave] gains an additional total Shield value +40%, and all allies gain Riposte DMG +25%.
euphoriaPaths.rank4: When an ally is being attacked, immediately cast a rank 1 [A New Wave] as a follow-up attack, triggers up to once per round; after allies riposte a total of 3 times combined, cast a rank 1 [A New Wave] as a follow-up attack, triggers up to twice per round.

euphoriaPaths.name: A Sonata Across the Stars
euphoriaPaths.rank1:
Gains Max Eureka +5. At the start of the round, gains Eureka +4. Whenever an ally consumes Eureka, accumulate points of [Inspiration]. When entering battle, accumulates 3 points of [Inspiration].
On odd-numbered attacks (#1, #3, #5 ...) [Impromptu Incantation] splits and attacks an additional enemy target, at a Final DMG Dealt -70% penalty to that target.
euphoriaPaths.rank2: After casting [Starlight Sonata] or [Concerto in D-fense], consume 2 Eureka to grant attack instance +1 to [Impromptu Incantation] for the round, and [Impromptu Incantation]'s split attack will select another 1 additional enemy target.
euphoriaPaths.rank3: After entering battle, Moxie +5. After casting [Galaxy on the Strings], Moxie +1. If the target is in the [Confusion] status, inflict [Where the Stars Lead] on the target for 3 rounds.
euphoriaPaths.rank4: [Galaxy on the Strings]: The requirements for dealing additional Mental DMG and for inflicting [Where the Stars Lead] are removed; grants 8 points of [Inspiration] to [Impromptu Incantation] for the round.

euphoriaPaths.name: Stealing Between Curtains and Walls
euphoriaPaths.rank1: After actively attacking, inflicts 1 stack of [Passion Drain] on the target.
euphoriaPaths.rank2: [Top Student] Enhancement: [Fixed Plan] is now granted to all allies and grants new additional effects: Ultimate Critical Rate +6% and Ultimate Critical DMG +6%.
euphoriaPaths.rank3: [Ridiculous Eyewitness Testimony] Enhancement: For each stack of [Fixed Plan], deals an additional 50% Mental DMG.
euphoriaPaths.rank4: When entering battle, gain Moxie +5 for self. Excess Moxie on allies is temporarily stored. At the end of the round, each character's stored Moxie is used to replenish their own Moxie if able. Each character can store up to 5 points of Moxie this way.

euphoriaPaths.name: The Dog Thinks, Therefore the Dog Exists
euphoriaPaths.rank1:
At the start of the round, grants a random effect from [Collection of Buffs] to the adjacent ally in front for 2 rounds; if the target is of the Mineral afflatus, grants 2 random effects instead.
If the adjacent ally in front is of the Mineral afflatus, after any ally takes an action, Pickles casts an additional rank 2 [Hedonism Implement] to attack the enemy with the highest HP percentage (triggers up to 1 time per round).
euphoriaPaths.rank2: After casting [Hedonism Implement], grant an additional 1 stack of [Rousing Morale] to the adjacent ally in front.
euphoriaPaths.rank3: At the start of the round, gain 1 stack of [Clarified Topic].
euphoriaPaths.rank4: After casting [Thus Spoke Pickles], grants extra action DMG Dealt +15% to the adjacent ally in front for 2 rounds; if the ally has the same afflatus as Pickles, the DMG Dealt is increased to +30%.

euphoriaPaths.name: A Waltz of Sweet and Sour Suffering
euphoriaPaths.rank1:
Gains Max Eureka +5. At the start of the round, gains Eureka +2. Whenever an ally consumes Eureka, accumulate points of [Inspiration]. When entering battle, accumulates 5 points of [Inspiration].
[Baby Tooth Collector]: Actively casting incantations no longer grants [Baby Tooth]; instead, Tooth Fairy gains 1 [Baby Tooth] for every 4 Eureka consumed by allies. At the start of the round, Tooth Fairy now consumes up to 5 [Baby Tooth]; for each Baby Tooth consumed, grants DMG Dealt +4% to the first 3 attack instances of [Impromptu Incantation] for the round and inflicts 1 stack of [Decayed Tooth] on all enemies.
[Baby Tooth Collector III]: Whenever a [Baby Tooth] is consumed, Tooth Fairy now restores (Missing HP x5%) HP for all allies and additionally grants 2 points of [Inspiration] to Impromptu Incantation for the round.
euphoriaPaths.rank2: [Empty Gums] New Effects: No longer inflicts [Confusion] on the target. Grants [Continuous Action I] for 1 round. After attacking, Tooth Fairy consumes 2 Eureka to grant attack instance +1 to Impromptu Incantation for the round.
euphoriaPaths.rank3: [Lullaby] New Effects: Consumes 2 Eureka to grant DMG Dealt +20% to Impromptu Incantation for the round.
euphoriaPaths.rank4: [Song for the Bad Tooth] New Effects: After attacking, grants 8 points of [Inspiration] to Impromptu Incantation for the round and inflicts [Neuralgia] on the target for 1 round.

euphoriaPaths.name: Nature's Prayer for Spring's Embrace
euphoriaPaths.rank1:
When entering battle and at the end of the round, gain 2 stacks of [Moss on Stone] for self; after an ally actively casts and attacks with an incantation, if the main target is in a [Poison] status, gain 1 stack of [Moss on Stone] for self.
At the start of the round, if holding 10 stacks of [Moss on Stone], then right before this unit actively casts and attacks with an incantation for the first time in the round, inflict an additional [Petrify] status on the main target for 1 round, and remove all [Moss on Stone] statuses on self at the end of the round.
Attacking an enemy in the [Petrify] status does not remove the [Petrify] status.
euphoriaPaths.rank2: [White Blankie]: At incantation rank 1/2/3, the Reality DMG bonus from each additional instance [Poison] is increased to 80%/120%/200%; and the [Petrify] status is regarded as 2 additional instances of [Poison].
euphoriaPaths.rank3: When actively attacking, if the main target is in the [Petrify] status, the attack gains Incantation Might +30%.
euphoriaPaths.rank4: When actively attacking, if the main target is in the [Petrify] status, the attack is always a critical hit.

euphoriaPaths.name: A Story Woven from Twigs
euphoriaPaths.rank1: When entering battle and at the start of every 3 rounds (Round 1, 3, 6, 9 ...), inflict [Mycelium Mayhem] on all enemies for 3 rounds.
euphoriaPaths.rank2: [Gaze From the Forest]: After hitting the target, immediately resolve [Poison] effects on all enemies.
euphoriaPaths.rank3: When [White Blankie] or [Good Friends] lands a hit, inflict 2 instances of [Poison] on the target hit for 2 rounds: at the end of the round, take (the user's ATK x30%) Genesis DMG. At the end of the round, if the enemy with the most [Poison] instances has at least 5 instances of [Poison], cast a rank 1 [White Blankie] on the enemy with the highest HP percentage and gain Moxie +1.
euphoriaPaths.rank4: [Mycelium Mayhem]'s effect: Poison DMG Taken +10%. Each time [Poison] is resolved on the holder, the user inflicts 1 stack of [Fungal Culture] on the holder for 3 rounds at the end of the round. When the target is inflicted with [Mycelium Mayhem], for every stack of [Fungal Culture] the target has, inflict 1 instance of [Poison] on the target for 2 rounds, deal (the user's ATK x30%) Genesis DMG at the end of the round, then remove [Fungal Culture] from the target.

euphoriaPaths.name: A Cosmos Reflected in Her Eyes
euphoriaPaths.rank1:
[Enchanted Strike] and [Mythical Meteors] deal an additional (base Mental DMG x40%) Mental DMG.
[Ultimate Perfection] deals an additional (base Mental DMG x40%) Mental DMG.
When actively cast, [Enchanted Strike] and [Mythical Meteors] are counted as follow-up attacks.
euphoriaPaths.rank2:
When entering battle, gains the maximum number of [Saturn].
[Saturn]/[Saturn Divination] additionally grant Critical Rate +(original Penetration Rate x100%).
[Mars]/[Mars Divination] additionally grant DMG Bonus +(original Leech Rate x100%).

Every time Kaalaa Baunaa removes [Planet] via her incantation or Ultimate, the following effects are triggered.
[Saturn] x1/2/3/4 removed: Casts rank 1/2/3/3 [Enchanted Strike] as a follow-up attack that deals an additional 80%/120%/160%/200% Mental DMG.
[Mars] x1/2/3/4 removed: Casts rank 1/2/3/3 [Mythical Meteors] as a follow-up attack that deals an additional 50%/80%/120%/150% Mental DMG.

euphoriaPaths.rank4:

After casting Ultimate, gains 1 effect based on the largest number of [Planet] removed.
[Saturn] x1/2/3+ removed: At the start of the next round, generates 1 rank 1/2/3 Precast Incantation: Enchanted Strike.
[Mars] x1/2/3+ removed: At the start of the next round, generates 1 rank 1/2/3 Precast Incantation: Mythical Meteors.
[Full Moon] x1/2/3+ removed: Gains 1/2/3 stacks of [Full Moon Divination].

euphoriaPaths.name: A Pilgrim's Duty
euphoriaPaths.rank1: After another ally casts an ultimate, gain 2 stacks of [Rippling Energy] for self.
euphoriaPaths.rank2: After casting an ultimate, consume all stacks of [Rippling Energy] if able; for every 2 stacks consumed, grant Moxie +1 to a random ally.
euphoriaPaths.rank3: Whenever consuming [Rippling Energy] to restore Moxie +1 for an ally, grant 5 additional stacks of [Ceremonious] to the target.
euphoriaPaths.rank4: After another ally casts an ultimate, gain an additional stack of [Rippling Energy] for self; right before casting an ultimate, gain 2 stacks of [Rippling Energy] for self.

euphoriaPaths.name: Never Divided by the World
euphoriaPaths.rank2: [Calculation of Genesis]'s condition for gaining Eureka changes from "after self casts an Incantation / after another ally takes an extra action" to "after any ally acts."
euphoriaPaths.rank4:
[Numeral Perception] is no longer a stackable buff; it becomes an ATK increase equal to 20% of 37's ATK, capped at 500.
[Kingdom of Geometry]'s [Numeral Perception] granted to all allies becomes 2 rounds; gains a new effect: self gains [Continuous Action I] for 2 rounds.
[Calculation of Genesis], when entering battle, changes its Critical Rate increase to affect all allies, with an additional Critical Rate increase equal to 50% of the base value, and gains a new effect: self Moxie +3, self Eureka cap +5, and all allied [Perception] characters' Ultimates no longer count toward the Spelldock Draw Limit.

euphoriaPaths.name: The Principle of Omnipresent Peace
euphoriaPaths.rank1: [Advocator of Knowledge]: [Discipline]'s Collection of Debuffs now includes Critical DEF -30%, Critical Resist Rate -20%, DMG Taken Reduction -20%, Reality DEF -20%, Mental DEF -20%, and [Fracture II]. [Discipline] now inflicts 2/4/6 effects for 2/3/4 rounds at rank 1/2/3; if the target has every effect included in the Collection of Debuffs, additionally inflicts 2/4/6 instances of [Poison] on them for 2 rounds and 3/6/9 stacks of [Burn]. Effects previously included in the Collection of Debuffs ([Blind] and [Mis-aim]) are now inflicted before casting Ultimate and last 2 rounds.
euphoriaPaths.rank2: [Advocator of Knowledge]: [Duty]'s Collection of Buffs now includes DMG Bonus +20%, Extra Action DMG Bonus +20%, Penetration Rate +20%, Incantation Might +30%, Ultimate Might +30%, and Genesis DMG Dealt +30%. [Duty] now grants 2/4/6 effects for 2/3/4 rounds at rank 1/2/3; Empower Incantation (no longer consumes Eureka) is now granted after the target has every effect included in the Collection of Buffs, and the target gains Eureka +10 afterward. Effects previously included in the Collection of Buffs (Mental DEF +15%, Reality DEF +15%, [Vitalize I], and [Ricochet I]) are now granted at the start of every round and last 2 rounds.
euphoriaPaths.rank3: [The Revelation] now consumes 6 Moxie to cast. New Effects: When entering battle, 6 gains Max Moxie +1. At the end of the round, 6 gains Moxie +2.
euphoriaPaths.rank4: [The Revelation] now deals an additional (base Mental DMG x100%) increased Mental DMG for each type of debuff on the target, and the number of times this DMG can be increased is doubled.

euphoriaPaths.name: Passion Burning Bright for Millennia
euphoriaPaths.rank1:
Accumulates [Lingering Glow] (mutually exclusive with [Bloodtithe]) whenever an enemy is inflicted with [Burn] or [Halo].
When entering battle, inflicts 6 stacks of Burn on all enemies.
Whenever allies inflict [Burn], [Lingering Glow] accumulation +100%. All enemies' [Burn] stack limits increase by 15.
euphoriaPaths.rank2: [Exhilaration] changes to: When casting an Ultimate, Critical Rate +5% and ATK +3% (stackable up to 10 times, removed after casting an Ultimate).
euphoriaPaths.rank3:
[Little Boxer]: Deals an additional (base Reality DMG x100%) Reality DMG. Critical DMG Bonus no longer requires [Preignition]. After attacking, inflicts 2 stacks of [Burn] on the target.
[Flame Flower]: Spathodea no longer requires critical attacks to inflict Burn. Instead, she inflicts 6 stacks of [Burn] on the target before attacking.
euphoriaPaths.rank4:
[Flame Within the Fire]: For each stack of [Burn] on the target, this attack gains Ultimate Might +2%. For every 10 points of [Lingering Glow], this attack deals an additional (base Reality DMG x5%) Reality DMG.
Spathodea can reserve up to 2 excess Moxie (replenished at the end of the round if applicable).

euphoriaPaths.name: Mycelium-Guided Wind Probe
euphoriaPaths.rank1: At the start of the round, if not under a [Pulsing Field] of any level, deploy [Pulsing Field Lv.1]. After an ally takes an action, they gain 10 stacks of [Dynamo]. At the end of the round, transfer up to 20 stacks of [Dynamo] into the [Pulsing Field].
euphoriaPaths.rank2: At the start of each round, plant 1 [Honey Fungus] and 1 [Ghost Fungus].
euphoriaPaths.rank3: When entering battle, gain 10 stacks of [Dynamo].
euphoriaPaths.rank4:
When casting a rank 1/2/3 [Protection to the Body] or [Stimulus to the Mind], the Current HP loss effect is reduced by a flat 10%.
[Stimulus to the Mind]: [Shield] duration +1 round. If a target already has a Shield, the new Shield value is stacked on top of the existing Shield, up to a maximum Shield value of (Max HP x60%) HP.
Gain [Amplified Surge]. When a mushroom matures, a [Stacked Shield] is triggered.

euphoriaPaths.name: Spores of Ever-Burning Spark
euphoriaPaths.rank1:
Whenever an ally loses HP, accumulate points of [Bloodtithe].
The ultimate no longer grants Eureka to other allies, and instead grants 6 points of [Bloodtithe].
At the end of the round, if [Bloodtithe] is at 5 or higher, for every 1 mushroom, recover (the target's Missing HP x8%) HP to other allies, this effect can critically hit.
euphoriaPaths.rank2:
When casting a basic incantation, lose an additional (own current HP x15%) HP, and the corresponding planted mushrooms is increased to 2.
[Stimulus to the Mind] is now changed to a healing incantation, changing its effect from granting Shields to all allies to recovering HP equal to the Shield's value to all allies.
When casting [Stimulus to the Mind], consume 2 points of [Bloodtithe] to grant Healing Done +30% to that action; and if own HP is below 50%, grant additional Healing Done +30% to that action.
euphoriaPaths.rank3:
When casting a basic incantation, if the mushrooms are maxed out, consume an additional 10% Current HP from all allies to grow all mushrooms 1 time.
This unit gains Healing Taken +20%.
euphoriaPaths.rank4:
When a mushroom matures, accumulate 1 point of [Bloodtithe] and recover (the target's Missing HP x20%) HP to all allies, this effect can critically hit.
At the start of the round, if [Bloodtithe] is at 15 or higher, consume 1 point of [Bloodtithe] and recover (the target's Missing HP x20%) HP to all allies.

euphoriaPaths.name: A Toast of Heavenly Nectar
euphoriaPaths.rank1:
The [Tipsy] status is no longer removed after being attacked by an ultimate. After another ally performs an extra action, grant 1 stack of [Liquor] and 1 stack of [Sublime Flow] to self.
When [Sublime Flow] is at maximum stacks, casting [Baijiu Ladle] will also cast a [Bottoms Up] of the same rank first before entering the [Tipsy] status.
euphoriaPaths.rank2:
When casting [Baijiu and Mayhem], for each stack of [Sublime Flow] held, gain Ultimate Might +4%, up to a maximum of +48%.
After casting [Baijiu and Mayhem], for each stack of [Sublime Flow] held, gain 1 stack of [Liquor].
euphoriaPaths.rank3: When gaining [Liquor] at the end of the round, also gain an equal number of stacks of [Sublime Flow].
euphoriaPaths.rank4:
After casting a rank 1/2/3 [Baijiu Ladle], gain 2/3/5 stacks of [Sublime Flow].
After another ally actively takes an action, Jiu Niangzi consumes a random number of [Liquor] stacks to cast a [Bottoms Up], this effect can trigger up to 3 times per round.

euphoriaPaths.name: Breeze Off the Mountain
euphoriaPaths.rank1:
Max Eureka +5. The [Array Maintenance] of [A Prophecy Told] becomes Eureka-consuming.
At the end of the round, if under [A Prophecy Told], does not gain Eureka +1 anymore. The number of Getian's Eureka gained by casting [I Shall Walk, Exist, and Know] changes to (the array's duration round count x2).
[A Prophecy Told] gains additional effects: When a Reality DMG character attacks, they gain an additional Ultimate Might +(original array's duration round count x13.5%).

euphoriaPaths.rank2: When entering battle, gains Moxie +1. At the end of the round, if under [A Prophecy Told], gains Moxie +1.
euphoriaPaths.rank3: After casting [Old Bones], additionally casts [Admonition] 1 time. This [Admonition] deals an additional ([Old Bones]'s Reality DMG) Reality DMG.
euphoriaPaths.rank4:
When Getian casts [Admonition] under [A Prophecy Told], Critical Rate and Critical DMG gained from [Bone Interpretor] are doubled.
When casting [I Shall Walk, Exist, and Know] under [A Prophecy Told], additionally casts [Admonition] 1 time. This [Admonition]'s Reality DMG +700%.

euphoriaPaths.name: Preciousness of the Past

At the start of the round, consumes 1/2 stacks of [Life Experience] to generate 1 rank 1/2 Precast Incantation - Reading Class, then consumes 1/2 stacks of [Life Experience] to generate 1 rank 1/2 Precast Incantation - From the Lantern if there is [Life Experience] left.
euphoriaPaths.rank2:
[Next Chapter]: All the [Preparation · Marcus] gained become rank 2 Precast Incantation - Reading Class.
When attacking, consumes 2 stacks of [Life Experience] to enhance incantation effect:
[Reading Class]: Deal an additional (base Mental DMG x100%) Mental DMG. At rank 3 incantation, Penetration Rate +30%.
[From the Lantern]: Deal an additional (base Mental DMG x100%) Mental DMG. If the target is in the [Annotate] status, deal an additional 90/120/225% Mental DMG.
[Next Chapter]: Deal an additional (base Mental DMG x100%) Mental DMG. If the target is in the [Annotate] status, deal an additional 600% Mental DMG.

euphoriaPaths.rank4: At the end of the round, upon gaining 8 stacks of [Life Experience], gains [Continuous Action I] for 1 round.

euphoriaPaths.name: The Elusive Glimmer of the Cosmos
euphoriaPaths.rank1:
[Restless Souls]: For each rank 2/3 incantation in the AP Area, deals an additional 100%/200% Mental DMG, up to a maximum of 1000%.
Rank 3 [Restless Souls] New Effects Added: After attacking, gains [Preparation · Mercuria] and [Simplified Ritual].
euphoriaPaths.rank2:
[Self-Focusing]: The duration of all allies' Critical Rate buff increased to 3 rounds.
New Effects Added: At the start of the round, gains rank +1 for a random own incantation.
euphoriaPaths.rank3: [Morning Star for the Night] New Effects Added: When attacking, for each stack of [Cosmic Energy], deals an additional (base Mental DMG x20%) Mental DMG and gains Ultimate Might +3%.
euphoriaPaths.rank4:
[Rank Up] New Effects Added: When attacking with a rank 3 incantation:
DMG Dealt +(DMG bonus gained from Mercuria's current [Cosmic Energy] x40%).
If under [Incantation Might Up], Incantation Might +(Incantation Might bonus gained from Mercuria's current [Cosmic Energy] x40%).
If under [Critical DMG Up], Critical DMG +(Critical DMG bonus from Mercuria's [Cosmic Energy] x40%).

euphoriaPaths.name: Tempering Fate Beneath His Wheels
euphoriaPaths.rank1:
[Bodily Furnace] Effects Enhanced:
When attacking, now gains an additional ATK +(base ATK bonus x100%).
[Bodily Furnace] Effects Changed:
After successfully inflicting [Burn] when attacking, gains the same number of [Burn] stacks (triggers even when inflicting excess stacks). Immune to [Burn] DMG. J's [Burn] stacks do not decrease when resolved.
[Bodily Furnace III] Effects Changed:
At the start of the round, triggers the following effects based on the number of J's [Burn] stacks (different effects can be gained multiple times):
At 10 stacks of [Burn] or above, grants DMG Taken Reduction +1% per stack of [Burn] to all allies for 1 round.
At 20 stacks of [Burn] or above, dispels all non-[Burn] [Neg Status] effects and 1 type of [Stats Down] or [Control] effect from J, and also dispels 1 type of [Neg Status], [Stats Down], or [Control] effect from all other allies.
At 30 stacks of [Burn] or above, grants Riposte DMG Bonus +1% per stack of [Burn] to all allies for 1 round.
euphoriaPaths.rank2: [Hardness Testing] no longer grants DMG Dealt bonus to all allies, but it now deals an additional (base Reality DMG x100%) Reality DMG, inflicts 6 stacks of [Burn], and counts as a riposte.
euphoriaPaths.rank3:
[Over the Haight Street!] now deals an additional (base Reality DMG x100%) Reality DMG. For each excess stack of [Burn] on the main target, this attack now deals an additional (base additional Reality DMG x500%) Reality DMG. After attacking, for each stack of [Burn] on J, grants DMG Bonus +2.5% to all allies for 3 rounds.
[Over the Haight Street!] does not take up the allied Incantation Limit.
euphoriaPaths.rank4:
[Heat Treating] now grants a Shield with (base Shield Multiplier x150%) HP; for each stack of [Burn] on J, Shield Multiplier +5%. If a target is already holding a Shield, the value of this Shield is stacked on top of that target's existing Shield, up to a maximum Shield value of (J's ATK x600%) HP.
[Tempering] now deals an additional (base Reality DMG x900%) Reality DMG and no longer deals more Reality DMG based on J's Missing HP. Instead, it now deals an additional (base additional Reality DMG from Missing HP x50%) Reality DMG for each stack of [Burn] on J. After attacking, gains Moxie +1 and grants a Shield with (J's ATK x90%) HP to all allies; for each stack of [Burn] on J, Shield Multiplier +2%. If a target is already holding a Shield, the value of this Shield is stacked on top of that target's existing Shield, up to a maximum Shield value of (J's ATK x600%) HP. Extends the duration of each ally's [Shield] to 3 rounds. J can gain Moxie and grant Shields this way up to 2 times per round.

euphoriaPaths.name: Leave Your Hopes at the Door
euphoriaPaths.rank1:
[Please, Come On In] now deals an additional (original Genesis DMG based on Tuesday's ATK and the number of [Poison] instances on the target x100%) Genesis DMG.
Tuesday now gains Moxie +1 after casting [Please, Come On In].
euphoriaPaths.rank2: [At Your Service] New Effects: Additionally gains Moxie +2 when entering battle. Ultimate does not take up the allied Incantation Draw Limit.
euphoriaPaths.rank3:
[In Mother's Arms] now additionally inflicts Critical Resist Rate -(original Critical Resist Rate reduction x100%) on targets in the [Poison] status.
[In Mother's Arms] now inflicts [Poison] DMG Taken +20% on targets in the [Poison] status.
euphoriaPaths.rank4: [At Your Service] now grants Moxie +1 to Tuesday and extends the duration of debuffs from [In Mother's Arms] on all enemies by 1 round at the end of the round if [Horror Story Night] is active.

euphoriaPaths.name: A Hundred Eyes Closed, Yet the Muzzle is Still Warm
euphoriaPaths.rank1: After actively taking an action, gains 5 stacks of [Incantation Bullet].
euphoriaPaths.rank2: [Grave Digger] New Effect: After attacking, grants rank +1 to a random own incantation. At rank 3, [Grave Digger] grants rank +1 to an additional random own incantation.
euphoriaPaths.rank3: [No Mark Unstruck] New Effect: Deals an additional (base Reality DMG x80%) Reality DMG to the target if they are [Pinpointed].
euphoriaPaths.rank4: [Grave Digger] New Effect: For every rank in the AP Area (up to 10 counted), [Grave Digger] deals 50% additional Reality DMG, grants 1 stack of [Ceremonious: Ultimate Might] to self, and has a 10% chance to cast [Grave Digger] an extra time.

euphoriaPaths.name: Depart the Earth on Open Wings
euphoriaPaths.rank1: [Hag's Bane] New Effects: [Poison] DMG Taken +5% (stackable); when exceeding stack limit, stacks with fewer rounds left are removed first.
euphoriaPaths.rank2: [Ancient Ritual] New Effects: At the end of the round, for every 2 stacks of [Hag's Bane] on the enemy with the most [Hag's Bane] stacks, Willow gains Moxie +1.
euphoriaPaths.rank3: [Hag's Bane] deals an additional (original Genesis DMG x100%) Genesis DMG.
euphoriaPaths.rank4:
[Ending Pose] New Effects: Gains Moxie +3.
[Hag's Steps] New Effects: At the end of the round, gains Moxie +2 if not channeling [Ancient Ritual].

euphoriaPaths.name: The Long Journey to Justice
euphoriaPaths.rank1:
When another ally performs an extra action, Liang Yue gains 1 stack of [Ritual Dance] for 2 rounds, up to 5 times per round.
[Guardian's Resolve] New Effects: Grants DMG Dealt +(original DMG Taken Reduction effect x100%). Grants additional Incantation Might +(original DMG Taken Reduction effect x50%) to attacks affected by Incantation Might.
[Arise, Qiangliang!]'s [Specified Selection] list now includes [Force Field] effects.
euphoriaPaths.rank2:
When casting [Bane of All Evil · Justice], [Peace Talon] is counted as [Justice Talon], and for each [Justice Talon] consumed, this attack gains ATK +0.5%.
When casting [Bane of All Evil · Peace], [Justice Talon] is counted as [Peace Talon], and for each [Peace Talon] consumed, this attack inflicts 1 stack of [Evil Expelled] on the targets for 1 round.
When casting [Bane of All Evil · Balance], for each [Justice Talon]/[Peace Talon] consumed, this attack gains Incantation Might +2%.
When casting [Bane of All Evil], this attack gains Incantation Might +5% for each stack of [Swift Resolve].
euphoriaPaths.rank3: [Call of Thunder: #0305] deals an additional 600% Reality DMG. [Arise, Qiangliang!] New Effects: When casting [Banish Evil] or [Bless Life], gains 1 stack of [Ritual Dance] for 2 rounds.
euphoriaPaths.rank4:
Liang Yue can no longer gain her Ultimate; instead, she automatically casts [Call of Thunder: #0305] at the start of the round if at 5 Moxie or above. When casting [Call of Thunder: #0305] while [Arise, Qiangliang!] is active, grants +1 round of [Immunity] and [Guardian's Resolve] to all allies, gains 2 stacks of [Swift Resolve], and grants Ultimate Might +100% to this attack.
[Arise, Qiangliang!] New Effects: [Banish Evil] and [Bane of All Evil] deal an additional ([Arise, Qiangliang!]'s base round duration x base Reality DMG x15%) Reality DMG.
[Ritual Dance] New Effects: At 4 stacks of [Ritual Dance], [Banish Evil] counts as an extra action when actively cast.
At 8 stacks of [Ritual Dance], the Reality DMG bonus of [Ritual Dance] is doubled; [Banish Evil] and [Bane of All Evil] additionally benefit from Incantation Might at a 40% rate.

euphoriaPaths.name: The Best Take
euphoriaPaths.rank1: [Prodigious Inspiration] reworked: no longer grants a chance to repeat the Ultimate directly. At the start of each round, if Moxie is at least 5 and [Prodigious Inspiration] reaches the amount previously consumed by the Ultimate, consume that amount to gain 1 stack of [Fountain of Ideas] (up to once per round). Each held stack of [Prodigious Inspiration] provides the original base chance to gain an additional stack of [Fountain of Ideas]. [Fountain of Ideas] stacks up to 4 times; if already at the cap, this conversion does not trigger or consume [Prodigious Inspiration]. [Fountain of Ideas]: each stack grants 1 additional repeat when casting the Ultimate; all stacks are removed after casting the Ultimate.
euphoriaPaths.rank2: [Miniature Set] gains new effects: Moxie +3 on entering battle. When another ally casts an Ultimate, gain 1 [Mise-en-scène], capped at the same limit as [Prodigious Inspiration]. [Mise-en-scène]: when Noire casts an Ultimate, Crit Rate +6% per stack and gain 12% additional Ultimate Might scaling. Consumed at the end of the turn in which it activates and cannot be dispelled.
euphoriaPaths.rank3: [Dramatic Moment] (Ultimate) no longer consumes AP and deals additional Mental DMG equal to 100% of its base Mental DMG. Its Penetration Rate bonus now counts types of [Status Ailment], rather than stacks. The cap on additional Mental DMG from different [Status Ailment] types is doubled. At Portrait 0: base Mental DMG increases from 450% to 900%; each type adds 100% Mental DMG and 3% Penetration Rate, up to 1000% and 30% respectively.
euphoriaPaths.rank4: [Dramatic Moment] gains new effects: the first repeat in the same round deals additional Mental DMG to all enemies equal to 50% of base Mental DMG. The second repeat also deals that 50% additional Mental DMG, and each type of [Status Ailment] on a target adds another 50% of the base per-type Mental DMG and Penetration Rate bonuses. The third and subsequent repeats deal 100% of base Mental DMG as additional damage to all enemies and add another 100% of both per-type bonuses. Repeat counts exclude the initial cast. At Portrait 0, the additional damage to all enemies is 450%/450%/900% respectively.

euphoriaPaths.name: A Universe Unbound Beyond the Mind
euphoriaPaths.rank1: [Eternally Inquisitive] Effects Enhanced: At the start of the round, if holding at least 1 stack of [Snake's Den], gains Moxie +1, consumes 1 stack of [Snake's Den], and generates a copy of [Hiss!].
euphoriaPaths.rank2:
[Ouroboros] New Effects Added: After attacking, inflicts 1 random effect from [Collection of Debuffs] on all enemies.
[Infinite Recursion] New Effects Added: After casting, grants [Stream of Consciousness] to all allies for 3 rounds.
[Eternally Inquisitive] Effects Enhanced: When attacking an enemy that's holding [Serpentine Scales], after Hissabeth gains Moxie and inflicts [Rigidity] on the target, she additionally inflicts 2 random effects from [Collection of Debuffs] on the target for 2 rounds.
euphoriaPaths.rank3: [Hiss!] now deals an additional (base Mental DMG x100%) Mental DMG and benefits from Ultimate Might at a +30%/60%/100% rate at rank 1/2/3.
euphoriaPaths.rank4: [Experimental Rocketry] now deals an additional (base Mental DMG x20%) Mental DMG for each type of [Neg Status] on the targets (counting up to 10 types); if there are at least 5 types, this attack gains Penetration Rate +20% and benefits from Ultimate Might at a +60% rate.

teamTierData.name: Shine bright like a diamond
teamTierData.rotation: Marsha and Isolde [E1] rapidly stack Burn & Lingering Glow on all enemies. Lorentz Butterfly rewrites Beryl's incantations to Rank 2/3 and raises the Glow cap, allowing Beryl to detonate multi-million prismatic beams.

teamTierData.name: Dynamo Electric Array ('Dynamo Wheelchair')
teamTierData.rotation: Charon & Enigma accelerate the Pulsing Electric Field straight to Level 3 while granting +1 AP and card shuffles. Ulrich's turrets and Brume's electromagnetic sweeps trigger automatically every turn.

teamTierData.name: Conduit Resonance Core
teamTierData.rotation: Hedone and Everecho link enemies and allies into a Conduit network. Rhiannon grants The Twins an Extra Turn burst window, causing every single-target strike to echo twice across linked bosses.

teamTierData.name: Bloodtithe Crimson Domain
teamTierData.rotation: Place Rubuska in Slot 4. Semmelweis [E1] opens the Blood Domain to drain allied HP into the Bloodtithe Pool while Sentinel fires counter-volleys, setting up Nautika [E1] for massive HP-scaling finishers.

teamTierData.name: Impromptu Inspiration Quartet
teamTierData.rotation: Paper Heron deploys her Eureka Array while Kiperina shields the crew. Matilda [E2] guarantees every end-of-round Impromptu musical barrage conducted by Barcarola critically strikes.

teamTierData.name: Bullet & Ultimate Artillery
teamTierData.rotation: Lopera [E1] maintains permanent Crucible Bullets while Moldir [E1] and Narcissus feed endless Moxie and Ultimate Might into Igor's zero-AP artillery Ultimates.

pullBanners.title: Everecho (6★ Spirit) & Cornerstone
pullBanners.verdict: If you run The Twins or Coppélia, Everecho is the dedicated Slot-4 sustainer that completes the T0 Conduit Core. Safe to stop at Portray 0 (P0).

pullBanners.title: Hedone (6★ Mineral) & Narcissus (6★ Plant)
pullBanners.verdict: Hedone solves single-target boss encounters for Conduit teams by inflicting artificial Conduit echo nodes. Narcissus is the premier healer/buffer for Igor and Recoleta Ultimate teams.

pullBanners.title: Beryl • Brume • Lorentz Butterfly • Charon • Rhiannon
pullBanners.verdict: New and returning Timekeepers should prioritize assembling either the Lingering Glow engine (Beryl + Lorentz Butterfly + Marsha) or the Dynamo Wheelchair (Brume + Charon + Enigma).

pullBanners.patch: Ripples on the Water (Euphoria Custom Banner)
pullBanners.title: Isolde [E1] • Semmelweis [E1] • Nautika [E1] • Lopera [E1]
pullBanners.verdict: Unlike dual 'Yearning of the Water' banners (which should be avoided), the Euphoria 'Ripples on the Water' banner guarantees your selected 6★ on the first 6★ pull! Pick Isolde (for Glow) or Semmelweis (for Bloodtithe).

tips: Choose the 'Harmonic Catalyst' or 'Catalyst of Artefacts' horn at the start of high-difficulty Delirium runs.
Collect 'Acoustica' relics for your main carry—Acoustica artefacts grant special rule-breaking passives to specific 6★ Arcanists.
If you lack a 3.x unit, use the 'Assist Recruitment' nodes on Floor 1 to borrow a max-portray Beryl or Brume!
dusk.title: A Series of Dusks — Roguelike Expansion

bosses.mechanic: Strips buffs from Slot 1 at the start of Phase 2. Place your primary carry in Slot 2 or carry a 'Silver Pendant' artefact for permanent Immunity.
bosses.recommended: Dynamo or Lingering Glow + Medication/Dagger Artefact Synergies

bosses.mechanic: Scales damage with your max HP artefacts; Bloodtithe teams reach 40,000+ HP in Dusk runs and one-shot the boss.
bosses.recommended: Bloodtithe (Nautika E1 + Semmelweis E1) + Vitality Relics

dusk.reward: Free 6★/5★ Garments, Wilderness Monuments, Gluttony & Clear Drops

tips: Use the Express Clear feature to skip straight to the final stages if you 3-starred the previous cycle.
Clear within 12 rounds on both halves for full stars; AoE engines like Dynamo (Brume/Lucy) and Conduit (The Twins) clear most waves in 2–3 rounds.
Spend your Oneiric Fluid in the Somnambulism shop on Sinister Shadows and Thoughts in Entirety.
limbo.title: Artificial Somnambulism / Lucidscape (Bi-Weekly Clear Drops)

bosses.mechanic: Two linked bosses revive each other unless defeated on the same round. Conduit splash damage guarantees both HP bars drop simultaneously.
bosses.recommended: Conduit Core (The Twins, Coppélia, Hedone, Everecho)

bosses.mechanic: High Reality DEF shield; bypass with Mental/Genesis damage or multi-hit Impromptu Inspiration barrages.

limbo.reward: 600+ Clear Drops & Oneiric Fluid every 1st and 16th of the month

tips: With 3.x powerhouses, hitting 1,500,000+ (Red SSS+) takes only 12–15 turns if you match the boss's favored mechanic.
Save burst Ultimates and Rhiannon Extra Turns for the phase-break stun window when the boss takes +50% amplified damage.
Always buy the monthly Gluttony and Crystal Casket from the Mane's Bulletin exchange first.
manes.title: Mane's Bulletin — SSS+ Boss Raids (30-Turn Endurance)

bosses.mechanic: Absorbs direct Physical hits, but takes +120% increased damage from Lingering Glow and Halo detonations. Beryl melts each health bar in 2 turns.
bosses.recommended: Lingering Glow Engine (Beryl, Lorentz Butterfly, Isolde E1, Marsha)

bosses.mechanic: Discharges paralyzing static every 3 rounds. Enigma's Bastion cleanses the paralysis while Brume & Ulrich siphon its charge to stay at Electric Field Lv. 3.
bosses.recommended: Dynamo Wheelchair (Brume, Charon, Ulrich, Enigma) or Bloodtithe

manes.reward: Gluttony (6★ Psychube Amplifier), Crystal Caskets, Sonorous Knells & Polarizers

tips: Depths of Myth spans Euphotic (10m–100m), Mesopelagic (110m–200m), Bathypelagic (210m–300m), Abyssal (310m–400m), Hadal (410m–500m), and Wailing Whirl (600m–1000m).
Transition Zones require 3 to 4 fully built, non-overlapping teams! Level your Myth Manifests in 'Isle of Echoes' to Level 30 before attempting 400m+.
Never let your weekly Trance cap hit 8/8! Every Monday at 05:00 server time you receive +4 Trance to sweep for Euphoria materials.
reveries.title: Reveries in the Rain — Permanent Endgame (Hadal & Wailing Whirl)

bosses.mechanic: High-depth bosses gain 'Abyssal Hardening' against off-archetype chip damage. Pair your Myth Manifest's active skill with your Carry's burst turn to break their poise gauge.
bosses.recommended: Team 1: Lingering Glow (Beryl) • Team 2: Dynamo (Brume) • Team 3: Conduit or Bloodtithe

bosses.mechanic: Equipment (Psychubes) and characters are locked per stage. Spread your 3 strongest sustains (Marsha, Enigma, Everecho/Rubuska) across the 3 nodes.

reveries.reward: Keys of Thought, Sprouts of Fantasy, Seeds of Inspiration & Clear Drops

homeManesBulletinBosses.name: Refracted Sun-Eater
homeManesBulletinBosses.weakness: Takes +120% amplified damage from Lingering Glow beams and loses 15% Mental DEF per Halo stack.
homeManesBulletinBosses.dangerMechanic: Solar Carapace absorbs direct Physical chip hits until broken by 5+ stacks of Burn or Lingering Glow.

homeManesBulletinBosses.name: Overloaded Automaton Core
homeManesBulletinBosses.weakness: Pulsing Electric Field Lv. 3 siphons the boss's static barrier and stuns its auxiliary turrets for 2 rounds.
homeManesBulletinBosses.dangerMechanic: Inflicts AoE Paralyzing Static every 3 turns; bring a cleanser or Bastion shielder to negate control.

homeManesBulletinBosses.name: The Crimson Sovereign
homeManesBulletinBosses.weakness: Entering the phase-break window multiplies HP-sacrifice Bloodtithe finishers and Conduit echo splashes by 1.8x.
homeManesBulletinBosses.dangerMechanic: Applies Bleed & Max HP corrosion to Slot 1; counter with Slot-4 Rubuska or Everecho's teamwide link heal.
